name: StrmBridge
description: StrmBridge is a background service that syncs your debrid provider library (RealDebrid/Torbox) to .strm files. It monitors your library and creates strm files that allow Jellyfin to stream content directly from the cloud without requiring local storage space.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Storage for the application database and internal settings.

paths.name: Strm Files Output
paths.description: This is where your .strm files will be created. Map this as a library source in Jellyfin.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: The port for the StrmBridge API service.

variables.name: Service Base URL
variables.description: The URL used to reach this service (e.g., http://192.168.1.50:9847). This address is written directly into the generated .strm files

variables.name: Sync Interval
variables.description: How often (in seconds) the service should check for library updates.
